geography: Phoenix metro in this registry means administrative Maricopa and Pinal counties. Service geography is not verified from DAC or account text. This is not statewide coverage and not every Phoenix school.

scope.window_enforcement: school year 2025 in this project means a transaction date on or after 2024-07-01. The registry records that start. The ingest does not delete a public line only because its date is earlier. In this public snapshot, screened lines with a check date or voucher batch date before 2024-07-01: 0.

snapshot.wording: This figure is the sum of screened public lines on that date basis. It is not unique spend, not the printed report total, not proof a payment settled, and not a census of districts or of Arizona schools.

transformations.step: Download the official URL and require the SHA-256 in pipeline/documents.py. A different hash is stored under its own name and is not indexed as this document.

Text-native Scottsdale AP PDFs use susd_ap_report_pdf. Diligent voucher account summaries use diligent_voucher_account_summary. Paper-capture scans use the OCR layout parser. A cover-page fund total is not a vendor line. A P-card merchant and its clearing-account payee stay on one line.

A document enters the public index only when parsed detail lines match the printed total on that same document. Paradise Valley stays out until a printed total can be reconciled. An unindexed file is not zero spending.

Check date, voucher batch date, and the native fiscal-year label are separate columns. A voucher batch date is not copied into check_date. School year 2025 in the registry means a transaction on or after 2024-07-01; the ingest does not drop lines solely for an earlier date. OCR batch dates are flagged ocr_batch_date_unreviewed and voucher_batch_date is null until reviewed. The raw OCR string may remain in voucher_batch_date_raw and is not a transaction date.
Amounts are integer cents from the printed dollars. Floats are not used for money.

Every public line is tagged reported_ap_or_vouchered_not_settlement. That is a reported AP or vouchered amount, not proof a payment settled. po_raw may sit on an AP line. The public sum uses amount_cents of that line, not a separate purchase-order commitment total. Govly purchase-order awards are excluded_secondary_PO and are not public lines.

A row is public only when the payee is classed safe_business_vendor and the vendor plus description have no email, phone, street address, long digit identifier, reimbursement or student context, authorized-user text, IEP or ESY, or medicaid, diagnosis, or prescription language. Personal and unknown payees are quarantined in the private silver table. The public table omits the row. Hiding a column is not the control. This is an AP and voucher extract, not a payroll register. Public lines generally do not include salaries. Withheld personal lines are not a payroll substitute.
Indexed public lines start with in_default_aggregate = 1. A line whose check date sits on an unresolved shared-date overlap is set to 0 and left out of the default total, charts, and CSV.

Categories use phoenix-k12-neutral-2026.11.06. Account titles are stronger than item text. Unclassified is the default. Amazon is a vendor, not a category. Categories are not USFR codes. Item groups are reviewed description phrases with a label, evidence span, method, and confidence. A not-to-exceed figure in the text is not the line amount.

aggregations.grain: one number for the lines in the current filter
aggregations.filter: in_default_aggregate = 1, plus the selected date basis and any search filters
aggregations.date_basis: either, unless the page selects check date or voucher batch date
aggregations.public_wording: This figure is the sum of screened public lines on that date basis. It is not unique spend, not the printed report total, not proof a payment settled, and not a census of districts or of Arizona schools.

aggregations.grain: calendar month of the selected date basis
aggregations.filter: in_default_aggregate = 1 and the month expression is not null
aggregations.date_basis: check date, voucher batch date, or check date when present otherwise voucher batch date
aggregations.public_wording: A month with no bar was not indexed, not recorded as zero.

aggregations.date_basis: same as the page filter; the chart does not relabel the basis
aggregations.public_wording: Inferred category, not a budget code

aggregations.grain: vendor_key, top 8 by amount_cents, remainder labeled Other screened vendors
aggregations.public_wording: Area is the sum of screened public lines for that vendor. Other screened vendors are grouped. This is not unique spend and not a printed report total.

Each bar is the screened public lines from the documents ingested for that district. Districts are not complete, not on the same calendar, and not comparable coverage. A missing district was not indexed. This is not a ranking of all Phoenix spending and not a share of any population.

aggregations.grain: two fixed public lines, not a ranked sample
aggregations.filter: in_default_aggregate = 1 AND ((description_public = '24 pack slow rise stress balls' AND amount_cents = 2063) OR (description_public = 'Tisaindor 100PCS Panda Stickers' AND amount_cents = 6469))
aggregations.date_basis: the line's own check date or voucher batch date, labeled on the card
aggregations.public_wording: Each card is one screened public line. It is not a finding, not proof a payment settled, and not the whole vendor or district.

aggregations.grain: item_label from a reviewed description phrase
aggregations.filter: in_default_aggregate = 1 AND item_label IS NOT NULL, plus the selected date basis
aggregations.date_basis: either, unless the groups page selects check date or voucher batch date
aggregations.public_wording: They are sums of screened public lines, not unique spend, not printed report totals, and not complete district or statewide coverage.

aggregations.grain: vendor_key; display name is the vendor_raw that occurs most often
aggregations.filter: in_default_aggregate = 1 and the selected date basis
aggregations.date_basis: either, unless the groups page selects check date or voucher batch date
aggregations.public_wording: This is not unique spend, not a printed report total, and not complete coverage of that vendor or of any district.

aggregations.filter: in_default_aggregate = 1 AND line_id IN (SELECT line_id FROM lines_fts WHERE lines_fts MATCH ?)
the same where() clause as the spending page, including in_default_aggregate = 1
aggregations.date_basis: the basis query parameter, defaulting to either

enrollment.what_it_is: ADE Accountability October 1 enrollment, LEA or district and school. This is not ADM.
enrollment.note: An ordinary GET of the official page returned HTTP 403 and a Cloudflare challenge. That response was not bypassed. No enrollment file was downloaded and no headcount was invented. A per-enrolled-student figure is not on the site. If a later fetch succeeds, it must be year-matched and labeled as reported amount in this index per enrolled student, not total cost per pupil. Salaries are not in this AP extract, and the index is not full-district coverage.
